arrival.finished.text: Craft {object} has arrived after {ticks} ticks (activity {activity} ends: 5 out of hyperspace, its order flying it from its next think; 7 out of a hangar, at its first think, its order flying it already), thinking every {interval} ticks; it follows {leader} (65535 when it leads)

arrival.started.text: Craft {object} starts arriving out of hyperspace (activity {activity}), for at most {ticks} ticks; a follower ends with its leader

attack.break.text: Craft {object} broke off from target {target}, {distance} units ahead inside its clearance of {clearance}, turning to yaw {yaw}

attack.break_end.text: Craft {object} ended its break from target {target} after {ticks} ticks ({reason}: outside, or the limit reached first), {distance} units away against its clearance of {clearance}

attack.break_lost.text: Craft {object} ended its break after {ticks} ticks: target {target} is no longer shown

attack.evade.text: Craft {object} jinked away from craft {threat} on its tail, to yaw {yaw} and pitch {pitch}

avoidance.steer.text: Craft {object} steered clear of craft {around}, {distance} units away with a clearance of {clearance}, to yaw {yaw}

notebook.unreadable.text: Craft {object}'s notebook could not be read ({error}); behavior {behavior} starts it again

order.no_behavior.text: No behavior flies order code {code}, the order of craft {object}; it drifts

program.crashed.text: The AI program failed with {error_type} at {where}: {error}; it stops with exit code 1

program.refused.text: A question broke the message format and was not answered ({error}); the AI program stops with exit code 2

program.started.text: The AI program started as process {pid}, reading messages of wire version {wire}

program.stopped.text: Standard input ended after {questions} questions; the AI program stops with exit code 0

think.answer.text: Craft {object} is answered with action bits {actions}: turn to heading {yaw}, pitch {pitch} and roll {roll}, throttle {throttle}, activity {activity}, think every {interval} ticks (0 where not sent); target {target} (65535 where not sent); cannon group 0 link mode {mode_first} burst {burst_first}, group 1 mode {mode_second} burst {burst_second}; fire launcher {launcher} (-1 for none), paired {paired}; aim {turrets} turrets; arrival {arriving} at speed {speed} (0 and 0 where not sent); notebook {notebook}

think.contact.text: Contact {object} (signature {signature}, type {type}, genus {genus}, team {team}, flight group {group}, object kind {kind}, flags {flags}) is at ({x}, {y}, {z}) heading {yaw} pitch {pitch}, speed {speed}, targeting {target}, last hit by {attacker} (65535 for none); shields front {front} rear {rear}, hull damage {hull_damage} of {hull}; activity {activity}; size {size}

think.question.text: The question for tick {tick} asks about {craft} craft and shows {contacts} contacts

think.turret.text: Craft {object} aims the turret in weapon slot {slot} at object {target} (65535 for none)

think.view.text: Craft {object} (signature {signature}, type {type}, flight group {group}, team {team}, skill {skill}) on order {order} in slot {slot}, activity {activity}, thinking every {interval} ticks, is at ({x}, {y}, {z}) heading {yaw} pitch {pitch} roll {roll}, speed {speed}, throttle {throttle}, random seed {seed}; order target mask {targets}, turret slot mask {turrets}; {cannons} cannon groups firing types {cannon_first} and {cannon_second}; {launchers} launchers holding types {warhead_first} and {warhead_second}, {left_first} and {left_second} left, ready in {cooldown_first} and {cooldown_second} ticks; enemy mask {enemies}, leader {leader} (65535 when it leads); notebook {notebook}
